releases.notes:
## CI fix
- vendored the mcef-keksuccino jar in-repo -- the Auto Build JAR workflow could not resolve it from Modrinth on a clean CI runner, silently blocking the jar asset on v1.1.7/v1.1.8 (had to be uploaded by hand). Fixed for real this time.

## New modules / features
- **AntiExploit, MotionBlur, SilentSwapOverlay** — closes GitHub issues #5, #4, #2. MotionBlur was rewritten as a real vanilla PostChain effect instead of the earlier Skija-hack approach, with time-independent decay and camera-motion-adaptive strength.
- **Silent toggles for BedAura AutoCraft and EvilRekit** — flip the underlying behavior without opening/flashing a visible GUI.

## Fixes
- **InfiniteChat**: the mixin redirect was patching the wrong `List.size()` call site — `allMessages` (raw history) got unlimited, but the actually-scrollable `trimmedMessages` list stayed capped at 100 lines, so busy chat still looked trimmed. Fixed to redirect the real trim loop (verified via `javap -c` against the 26.1.2 merged jar). Added a Spam test toggle for repro.
- **BetterChams**: flat fill was silently skipped when it was the only active effect.
- **SilentContainer/AutoCraft**: GUI suppression missed `extractBackground`, letting it flash through.
- **GifHUD**: fixed "Link is already loaded!" getting stuck and permanently blocking retry.
- **HoleSnap**: render-thread chat crash fixed; ServerGate kingmc-switch flicker fixed.
- **MusicHUD**: added a sequence counter guarding YouTube/Spotify thumbnail fetches against out-of-order completion — a slow request for an old track could land after a fast request for a newer one and stomp the fresher album art.
- **BedAura**: recompute cadence relaxed 4→10 ticks (redundant target rescans cut; `currentSelectionStillGood` still runs every tick between recomputes so drift is still caught immediately).
- **build.gradle**: `runBoze` task marked never-UP-TO-DATE — was intermittently getting skipped as a no-op; guarded `copyToMods` so CI builds don't fail on a dev-only path.
- Removed the MatrixSwap experiment and reverted PearlPhase velocity compensation (regressed accuracy).

## PearlPhase
- Yaw-sector straight-throw is now the default behavior, no toggle needed.
- General accuracy/behavior improvements to the sector-based aim.

## Docs
- Rewrote dev-jargon option descriptions in plain user-facing text across the GUI.

## Hotfix

**Critical:** fixed an infinite loop in InfiniteChat's chat-history mixin that permanently froze the game ("Not Responding") the moment chat history passed 100 lines while InfiniteChat was enabled. Any chat/system message could trigger it -- confirmed via a live thread dump (render thread stuck in one call for 2M+ ms CPU).

### Other fixes this release
- **PearlPhase**: the thrown pearl inherits your movement velocity (`Projectile#shootFromRotation` adds the thrower's velocity on top of the aim vector). A near-vertical clip throw carries very little horizontal speed, so sprint-strafing redirected the pearl sideways into a neighbouring block -- the "pearl bounces up" case when moving diagonally past a freshly placed block. The aim is now rotated to cancel the inherited velocity; standing-still throws are unchanged.
- **HoleSnap**: a hole that can't be entered for a *vertical* reason (a roof over it, an overhang, standing on the block above it) was never detected -- CollisionDisable only counts horizontal obstruction -- so the module held you in place indefinitely. It now gives up and disables when it stops making progress toward the hole. Also fixed auto-disable not firing once you were correctly in the hole.
- **AutoAccept**: fixed a feedback loop where the server's own "You accepted the teleport request" confirmation was mistaken for a new incoming request, spamming `/tpaccept` (spam-kick risk).
- **PlayMusic**: autoplay now stops after 3 consecutive failed-to-load tracks instead of retrying instantly forever (was flooding chat and the main thread); font loading and YouTube OAuth device-code request moved off the render thread (were blocking, uncaught stalls).
- **MusicHUD**: font resolution moved off the render thread (native font-matching fallback chain could block for real time on some systems).
- **BedAura**: removed SuppressAutoMine (no longer force-switches AutoMine's Instant mode to Strict around bed placement).

[+] Added Flare mode for BetterChams

[+] Added PathFinder: Use Boze's ElytraFly and block firing firework's action of baritone. To use, set #goal and do #elytra, then turn on PathFinder. (note: you still have to bring at least 5 fireworks so baritone can work).
